name: Freifrau
short: A company that builds your favourite piece.
long:
What started back in 2011 as a one-man show has now, in little more than a decade, become an established European design brand: Freifrau Manufaktur. Operating from Lemgo, a small town in Westphalia, Germany, this exclusive manufacturer of seating furniture is characterised by high levels of comfort, lovingly-rendered details, and exacting quality and sustainability standards.

In 2011, trained carpenter Hansjörg Helweg decided to resign from his job and set up Freifrau, a brand for seating furniture which, right from its beginnings, has always been different.

Freifrau furniture is elegant, stylish and, true to the meaning of its name in German (literally ‘free woman’), often decidedly feminine, which is why its collections are called by female forenames. Amelie was the first Freifrau chair and remains a stalwart of the range to this day, her shell given a variety of frames over the years: rails, cantilevers, circular bases, wooden cross. The same is true of the second line, Leya. It is in the company’s DNA to combine and develop its product lines, offering a wide range of textiles and leathers for each variant.
